name: LACHNANTHES TINCTORIA
key_symptoms: Sensation of heat-bubbling and boiling around heart region rising to head.

Right-sided pain, extending down to jaw; head feels enlarged; worse, least noise. Scalp painful. Sleepless. Circumscribed red cheeks; scalp feels sore, as if hair was standing on end; burning in palms and soles. Bridge of nose feels as if pinched.
Chilliness between the shoulder-blades; pain and stiffness in back.
Neck.--Drawn over to one side in sore throat. Rheumatism of the neck. Stiffness of neck. Pain in nape, as if dislocated.
